ns2:section.sectionText: The Structure of Ballparks. This course traces the history of ballpark design and construction from a structural engineering perspective. Topics include material selection and structural system options, as well as functional and architectural considerations. Evolution of baseball stadiums from simple wooden structures to modern steel and concrete ballparks is examined, including treatment of cantilevered trusses, precast concrete components, facades, and retractable roof structures. Engineering examples are also drawn from recent renovations and expansions of historic baseball stadiums. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
